newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meets chief-of-staff Chubais in sanatorium.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meets chief-of-staff Chubais in sanatorium.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin met chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais on Thursday, Interfax news agency quoted Yeltsin's press office as saying.
Interfax said the meeting, a regular one between the two men, had started at 12.30 p.m. (0830 GMT) and was expected to last about an hour.
Yeltsin, who spent over three weeks in hospital while doctors prepared the ground for an operation on his heart, moved to the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow last weekend.
The operation is due in the next two months.
Rumours that the 65-year-old president had died emerged in several international financial markets on Wednesday and were strongly denied by his press office in Moscow.
